name: io.github.iusserhat/horkos
title: Horkos
description: Escrow for AI agent purchases on NEAR testnet: pay only when a TEE verifies the delivery.

environmentVariables.name: HORKOS_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Agent account with a function-call key for create_order and cancel_order

environmentVariables.name: HORKOS_OWNER
environmentVariables.description: Mandate owner whose budget the agent spends

environmentVariables.name: HORKOS_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ed25519 function-call key of the agent; if unset, read from ~/.near-credentials/testnet/<agent>/
